meaning: Time’s mould (7 left out = the “DC” / zero-point slot)
plain: A fixed product that this model treats as Time’s shape.
Flip the digits and multiply — you land on the same number.
Earth’s long wobble cycle fits inside that same mould number.
A building-block energy unit tied to simple hydrogen (protium).
Time’s mould divided by that unit gives 4 — treated as “matter.”
A hydrogen-related seed scales straight up to Time’s mould.
That angle shows up in the cones and pyramids on the device.
